svg.title: Roadmap: four phases, each followed by a measurable gate; the external autoscaler can be stopped after phase 1
svg.text: Four phases, each followed by a measurable gate; the external autoscaler can be stopped after phase 1
The evaluation loop of the autoscaler on the leader, with the existing policy format
engine field, ListPolicies filter, built-in plugins, internal Job.Scale call
Gate: the two engines run side by side without double scaling; the cooldown survives a leader change
a load test with 1,000 task groups passes
check block in HCL2, jobScalingValidate admission hook
Scaling event topic, deployment block, rate limit, oscillation guard
Gate: job plan rejects a faulty rule; jobs in the old format run unchanged
in a mixed-version cluster the Raft log stays readable
client-side push in the Node.UpdateAlloc message, leader-side collector
nomad.cpu and nomad.memory sources, replacing the nomad APM plugin
Gate: no per-allocation Stats RPC; the metric drift against the client's own measurement is small
after a leader change no scale-down until the first full window
scaling block in the node pool specification, cloud target plugins
drain with the built-in drainer before scale-down
